text: Store realized harness cost on the idea next to its estimate (data model change)
description: Today a cycle's USD cost and tokens live in the trace (.bowman/runtime/traces, local, newest 200). For the priority-model calibration (b2a7c3cf: estimated vs actual on 30+ ideas) it must be durable in the graph. Proposal: optional field on an idea = summed realized cost of harness cycles that worked on it, added by the record stage; git versions it (no history arrays). Needs a migration per AGENTS.md (bump dataModelVersion, fixture of the previous format), plus a decision on the unit.

status.comment: Data model 8: ideas carry optional realizedCostUsd, the summed actual cost of harness cycles in nominal US dollars (unit as decided with 5c1ccaa8; compounding/discounting stays computed). Backend idea.addRealizedCost({space, ideaId, usd > 0}) adds under the idea's file lock; the loop worker's record step calls it whenever a cycle's cost is known (a failure only logs). Migration v8 is a no-op version move (like v7) so older code stops writing; frozen fixture data-model-v7; protocol schemas regenerated and protocol/README says version 8 and documents the field (also fixed its stale /g/<slug> host form to /spaces/<slug>). Evidence: backend test 'an idea sums what harness cycles on it actually cost' (0.25 + 0.5 = 0.75, cost estimate untouched, negative refused); cycle.test priced cycle writes ['leaf', 40]; migration tests incl. data-model-v7 15/15; pnpm verify:migration on v7 and ~/life: no conflicts, value calc ok; pnpm check 25/25. Only CLI-executor and priced API cycles record; Claude Code sessions driven by the Stop hook don't go through the harness and record nothing.
